text:
maria.cho: Quick heads-up — we're running a tabletop/dry-run tomorrow 10:00am PT for an airgapped private deployment scenario: rotate customer keys, simulate KMS outage, and test RBAC rollback. Need sec + ops present.
kevin.liu: +1 from infra. Do we want HashiCorp Vault ephemeral leases or the cloud KMS shim for the sim?
sasha: I'd prefer vault ephemeral leases for the failover test, gives us token lease expiration behavior. We should also validate audit log forwarding to the on-prem SIEM before we start.
eli_ops: Can we scope the RBAC change to a specific namespace + service account so blast radius is tiny? Also want to confirm egress is blocked to public KMS endpoints in the airgapped env.
maria.cho: Yes — plan is: 1) swap KMS provider to local Vault for target cluster, 2) perform a key rotation + force revoke leases, 3) run RBAC rollback that revokes cluster-admin and grants scoped role to binder SA, 4) validate app decrypts and fallback behavior.
kevin.liu: For the network side, I'll apply a temporary netpol that only allows kube-system->vault namespace over mTLS port 8200 and blocks 443 egress. Example:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-to-vault-only
  namespace: demo-app
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          vault: "true"
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8200
```
eli_ops: Nice. Also add an auditd rule to capture process execs for the keystore agent. Example: `-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S execve -k keystore-exec`
sasha: On logging: ensure Fluentd forwarder in the airgap is writing to the SIEM collector over the private peering; we'll ship a synthetic event after rotation to validate.
maria.cho: Incident playbook note: if token revocation causes mass decrypt failures, fallback policy is to switch route to read-only replica using static keys (controlled rollback). We should timebox the experiment to 15 minutes and have an oncall on standby. @oncall-bot can you create the runbook ticket?
oncall-bot: runbook created: RBAC-KMS-Airgap-DR, assignees: eli_ops, kevin.liu, sasha — link: https://internal/runbooks/RBAC-KMS-Airgap-DR :white_check_mark:
eli_ops: I'll stub the rollback script and a canary probe that attempts a decrypt every 10s and posts results to #eng-security-test.
kevin.liu: Also worth noting CVE surface: the keystore agent used in onprem has a pending patch for CVE-2025-1111. For the sim we'll run the patched image, but we should include a failure mode where the agent is unavailable to exercise fallback.
sasha: Good catch. Add that to the runbook steps under 'vuln triage' so security can validate exploitability matrix.
maria.cho: Ok team — agenda for tomorrow: 9:30 prep call, 10:00 start sim, 10:15 rollback window. Bring logs and SIEM correlation links. If anything looks off, abort and run containment. :thumbsup:
